name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Cashew Stir-Fry over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 green bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
Place soy sauce, oil, cornstarch, vinegar, and sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Seed and medium dice bell peppers.
Cut chicken thighs into ½-inch pieces.
Heat a large pot over high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, and bell peppers; continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 4-5 more minutes.
Pour sauce into the pot. Reduce heat to medium-high and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions on a clean cutting board and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Add cashews to the pot and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with chicken stir-fry and green onions. Enjoy!
